title: stable is deprecated
summary: npm states that modern JavaScript engines already provide stable Array.prototype.sort behavior, so the stable package is deprecated.

constraints: Preserve comparator behavior, input mutation, output ordering, and support for the project's minimum JavaScript runtime.

steps.title: Use native stable sorting
steps.instructions: Replace stable package calls with Array.prototype.sort using the same comparator, then remove the dependency.

verification.purpose: Run ordering and repository tests on every supported runtime.
